title: Make VixenApp's MSVC /bigobj requirement declarative
body: The native Release VIXEN graph reached 715/1283 then MSVC C1128 failed on VIXEN/application/main/source/graph/BuildRenderGraph.cpp. I added /bigobj to the existing VixenApp MSVC target options so the native target can compile. Consolidate the native MSVC object-format compatibility policy in the shared preset/target configuration; tier:luna, effort:S because this is a scoped one-target build-contract fix with a native witness.

title: Native GPU suite should provision ctest.exe on the Windows PATH
body: The queued native suite wrapper failed before CTest with 'ctest.exe is not recognized' because cmd.exe did not inherit CMake's bin directory. Recovery added C:\PROGRA~1\CMake\bin to PATH before tools/run-native-gpu-suite.bat. Make the native suite wrapper discover or provision its CMake ctest executable as part of the declared run contract.

title: Native build summary helper should construct a valid Windows status temp path
body: Every queued native build completed, but VIXEN/scripts/build/run_build_with_summary.ps1:111-112 repeatedly emitted Set-Content/Move-Item errors for the literal path C:\vixen-native\gpuwin\".tmp. The build ID summary still printed and the workaround was to treat the status failure as non-fatal. Build status persistence should normalize the temporary path before writing it.

title: Serialize native UI asset staging during the full VIXEN build
body: The first queued native Release all graph failed at test_ui_composition_host.exe when parallel post-link cmake -E copy_directory staging raced; source and destination contained the same assets afterward. The scoped lookdev target and the subsequent queued build passed. Make UI asset staging an ordered/atomic build step or otherwise serialize the copy operation.
